_comment: Engine 2's operating parameters. Every value names the rule that argues for
it. The regulatory ones (A1-A5) are NOT tunable here — they are resolved from
policy_engine.py and repeated in this file only so a reader can see them
beside the numbers that are ours. Changing a Vasooli value here without
changing the skill makes the citation a lie; changing a regulatory value here
changes nothing at all, because the gate does not read it.

notice_window.note: target_lead_hours is the midpoint the scheduler aims a fresh notice at. The midpoint is ours; the 24-48h window is not.

attempts.note: Mirrors ENGINE_LIMITS[MANDATE_RECOVERY]. The policy engine is the enforcer; a mismatch here is caught by a test rather than silently honoured.

afa.note: Read from the registered `afa_fresh_auth` threshold, repeated here for display only.

dunning.note: Below this the draft is treated as unreliable and the per-failure-class template applies. Same floor the shared classifier uses; a message is not a place to act on a guess.

blind_retry_baseline.note: The counterfactual the wasted-attempts figure is measured against: a system with no soft/hard split would spend the whole per-cycle budget on every failure. Stated so the number is arguable rather than impressive.
